provider_organization: ERSU Messina (Ente Regionale per il Diritto allo Studio Universitario), Region of Sicily

stipend.notes: Total value (cash + housing + meals). Base: off-site/independent EUR 7,171.11; commuter EUR 4,190.71; in-town EUR 2,890.16. +15% if ISEE at most half the limit (off-site EUR 8,246.77); reduced gradually to half (min EUR 3,585.55 / 2,095.35 / 1,445.08) if ISEE above two-thirds of the limit. +20% for women in STEM (not combined with the 15%). Value of free housing/meals is deducted from cash. First-year students: halved if they have fewer than 15 credits by 10 Aug 2027 but 20 by 30 Nov 2027.

additional_benefits: Housing (free place in ERSU or partner residences, separate 'servizio abitativo' request on the same form)
Graduation bonus +50% for on-time graduates, only if funds remain

application_fee.notes: No fee to ERSU. Winners must be enrolled at UniMe and have paid the regional tax for the right to study by 21 Apr 2027.

eligibility_criteria.min_gpa: First year: merit checked afterwards (credits by 10 Aug / 30 Nov 2027). Later years: minimum credits by 10 Aug 2026 (bando tables 3 and 5.x, per 2 Jul 2026 errata). PhD only if the PhD place is unpaid.
language_proficiency: None required for the grant itself

country_specific_notes.note: Non-EU students with family abroad need an 'ISEE parificato' calculated by a CAF from family income and assets in Nigeria, with Nigerian documents translated into Italian and legalised where required. Upload by 16 Sep 2026 for a normal ranking place; uploads up to 30 Nov 2026 are accepted but go to the bottom of the ranking.

required_documents.name: Family income and asset documents from the home country
required_documents.detail: Translated and legalised (as the CAF requires)

required_documents.name: Residence permit or receipt of the permit application

preparation_alerts: Income limits: ISEE up to EUR 22,500 AND ISPE up to EUR 53,000
Get the ISEE parificato from a CAF early; you can apply with only the declarant's tax code and add values later, but by the correction deadline
Legalising and translating Nigerian income documents takes weeks
International students must validate the application with an OTP code by 18 Aug 2026 15:00
Enrol at the University of Messina and pay the regional tax by 21 Apr 2027 or lose the benefit
